sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER

This is third application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.04/2023 registered at Police Station-Gunga,
District-Bhopal (MP) for the offence under Sections 363, 366-A, 376(3), 323, 506, 342 of the IPC and Section 5/6 of the POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 02.01.2023.
Applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.

It is submitted that earlier applicant i.e. MCRC No.35094/2023 was dismissed vide order dated 16.08.2023 with direction that Kripal Singh Rajput vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151756102/

sentences.text: applicant is at liberty to file repeat application after period of three months, if prosecutrix is not examined in Court.
Prosecution was also directed to serve notice on the witness and keep the prosecutrix present before Court for examination.
Prosecutrix is not appearing in Court since 17.02.2023.
She is yet to be examined in Court.
Period of three months is over.
In these circumstances, applicant may be released on bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail.
4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5. On perusal of order sheet, it is found that prosecutrix is not appearing in the case for her evidence after 17.02.2023.
Prosecution was unable to keep the prosecutrix present in Court for her examination despite orders from this Court.
Liberty was granted to applicant to file repeat application, if prosecutrix is not examined in Court within three months.
Applicant is in jail since 02.01.2023.
6. Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting on the merits of the case, bail application stands allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial C o urt concerned for his regular appearance before Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of trial.
